sources.entry: F-Droid - Server tools for maintaining an F-Droid repository system. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker/deb

summary.name: fdroidserver
summary.one_liner: Server-side tools for building, indexing, updating and deploying F-Droid app repositories.
use_cases: host your own F-Droid app repository
automate builds of Android apps for F-Droid
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab repository for fdroidserver, the tools used to manage builds, indexes, updates and deployments for F-Droid repositories. The page itself shows a branch/tag selector (master plus tags from 2.2.0 up to 2.4.5) and an empty file listing, so it contains little detail beyond the project's purpose. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as server tools for maintaining an F-Droid repository system, written in Python with Docker and deb packages available, under AGPL-3.0.
notable: Official server-side toolset for F-Droid repositories
Versioned releases through tags such as 2.4.5
Available as Python code, Docker image and deb package
caveats: Page text is mostly repository navigation with little feature documentation
Usage details are not shown on this page
